# Edges for the Anvil

*The Anvil blunts Ulric's chisels faster than he can sharpen them. Bring him 20 Newt Hides for a strop, and take his word to Gorm about his mallet grip.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Goa Harbour](../towns/goa_harbour_quests.md) |
| Category | Side |
| Given by | [Ulric](../npcs/ulric_stonecarver.md) |
| Level | 38 |
| Leads to | [The Hardest Step](../quests/ulric_the_hardest_step.md) |

## Objectives

1. Bring 20 [Sea Newt Hide](../items/newt_hide.md) (taken)
2. Talk to [Gorm](../npcs/gorm_stairs.md)

## Rewards

- 11,500 EXP
- 1,500 mesos
- [Sea-Herb Tonic](../items/sea_herb_tonic.md) x10
- +20 standing with Goa Harbour
- +150 standing with [Ulric](../npcs/ulric_stonecarver.md)
